summary: Fills five consecutive DWORD slots starting at a caller-supplied pointer with the same integer value passed in a2, then returns the pointer. Unconditional small utility for initializing a five-element integer array or struct region.

local_names.result: pointer to the destination DWORD array
local_names.a2: integer value written into all five slots

operations.description: Write a2 into the first DWORD slot at offset 0x0 of the destination array.
Write a2 into the second DWORD slot at offset 0x4 of the destination array.
Write a2 into the third DWORD slot at offset 0x8 of the destination array.
Write a2 into the fourth DWORD slot at offset 0xC of the destination array.
Write a2 into the fifth DWORD slot at offset 0x10 of the destination array.
Return the destination pointer to the caller.

unresolved: No guard, callee, global, or caller evidence present in the packet; ownership of the destination object is unknown.
Whether the five slots form an array versus distinct struct fields cannot be established from this function alone.
